title: Participation in mediation.
bodyText: An attorney or other individual designated by a party may accompany the party to and participate in a mediation. A waiver of participation given before the mediation may be rescinded.
bodyHtml: [§658H-10]  Participation in mediation.  An attorney or other individual designated by a party may accompany the party to and participate in a mediation.  A waiver of participation given before the mediation may be rescinded. [L 2013, c 284, pt of §1]
